leadText: The legendary heroes are a duo of Legendary Pokémon that appeared in Pokémon Journeys: The Series. The members are Zacian and Zamazenta who played a part in the Darkest Day.
plainText:
The legendary heroes are a duo of Legendary Pokémon that appeared in Pokémon Journeys: The Series. The members are Zacian and Zamazenta who played a part in the Darkest Day.

==In animation==
===Zacian===
 
 debuted in Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!, when encountered it in the Slumbering Weald after getting separated from Goh. After getting no data on Zacian from his Rotom Phone, Ash attempted to battle it with , only for the attack to pass through Zacian before it disappeared.

In Sword and Shield: From Here to Eternatus!, Goh and Sonia arrived at the Slumbering Weald requesting the help of it and to deal with the Darkest Day crisis that had befallen Galar. Zacian appeared alongside Zamazenta and led Goh and Sonia to the Altar where they found the Rusted Sword and Shield.

In Sword and Shield: The Legends Awaken!, by using the Rusted Sword, Zacian turned into its Crowned Sword form and battled alongside Zamazenta in its Crowned Shield form and was able to take down , allowing it to be caught by Goh. After the battle, Ash and Goh returned the Rusted Sword and Shield to the Altar.

Zacian reappeared in a flashback in Detective Drizzile!.

Zacian reappeared in a flashback in Heroes Unite!.

=====Personality and characteristics=====
Zacian is a loyal Pokémon, as seen during the Darkest Day crisis, when it led Goh and Sonia to the Altar where they'd find the Rusted Sword and Shield.

Zacian is also a strong Pokémon, as seen in Sword and Shield: The Legends Awaken!, when it took on alongside and was able to defeat it.
